sessions.read.description: List agent sessions and multiplexer targets.

events.read.description: Subscribe to the normalized event stream.

inbox.read.description: Read pending inbox items including command detail.

approvals.write.description: Resolve permission/question items. Requires a one-time action token per decision.

repos.read.description: Read git status, diffs, trees and blobs inside allowlisted repository roots.

files.read.description: Read file contents inside allowlisted roots.

preview.proxy.description: Proxy HTTP/WebSocket/SSE to allowlisted loopback ports.

devices.read.description: Read sanitized Tailscale device candidate metadata from the connected host.

uploads.write.description: Write image/file attachments into the upload directory only.

non_capabilities: There is no arbitrary command execution endpoint. The app already owns an authenticated SSH/PTY channel; adding remote exec to the structured daemon would only widen the blast radius.

request_signing.notes: Timestamp outside the skew window or a replayed nonce is rejected with 401. The device token authenticates; the signature binds the request.
